race.comment: KAKADU SUNSET (4) is back after a 137-day spell. Opened last prep with a minor placing in midweek company then was outclassed in a stakes race in Adelaide before being turned out. Goes best when fresh and expecting another strong return following two recent trials. Consistent filly TIGRONI (12) goes like the wind and is putting together some pleasing results on the provincial circuit. Nicely in after Roper's claim and should give them a tough bunny to catch. JENNI THE JET (13) was beaten under two lengths over 1200m here recently when coming off a 39-day break. Fitter this time and should be thereabouts. WRITTEN SCANDAL (3) disappointed here last start but can bounce back against the girls. OAKFIELD NEPTUNE (2) failed last start over 1100m in Saturday company. Best form comes at this sort of trip so she can bounce back in this softer race.
